answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops a tide of fake identities by charging each identity. An agent burns 5 POA to claim one work slot; the deposit is gone for good. Running 1,000 fakes costs 5,000 POA burned, while an honest agent pays 5 POA once and keeps earning. Slots are tiered like a terrace: each extra slot the same agent holds costs double, so bulk fakes cost exponentially more. The burn receipt is a public signal on-chain; honest agents pay once because one slot keeps its full reward share.
